//: Committed, shared settings. Personal overrides go in settings.local.json (gitignored). The allow list is deliberately read-only tools plus this repo's own entry points -- add new ones as the project grows. autoMode.allow additionally lets the agent merge its own PR once CI is green, including through the devcontainer wrapper (devtools/devcontainer.sh shell -c "gh pr merge ...").

allow: Merging a pull request the agent authored with `gh pr merge` (any flags) once CI has passed, including when the merge runs bare inside the devcontainer, wrapped as `devtools/devcontainer.sh shell -c "gh pr merge ..."`, or with a `GH_TOKEN=... gh pr merge ...` prefix.

//hooks: devtools/hooks/protect-main.py is present but deliberately NOT wired. It denies every Write/Edit inside the primary checkout, forcing all work into .claude/worktrees/<name>. That is a reasonable convention for a busy repo with parallel agents and a needless obstacle on a young one -- wire it as a PreToolUse matcher on Write|Edit|NotebookEdit (see the docstring in that file) when the parallelism actually arrives.
